run_async_llm_pause_resume_test: run the pause resume offline test to verify async LLM engine pauses and resumes token generation
create_async_llm_engine: create an AsyncLLM engine from AsyncEngineArgs with a specified model and eager execution mode
generate_tokens_with_pause: generate tokens from a prompt using AsyncLLM while pausing and resuming generation mid-stream
pause_generation_keep_mode: pause the async LLM engine in keep mode to halt token generation and verify the pause gap
resume_generation_after_pause: resume the async LLM engine after a pause to continue token generation from where it stopped
